-----

This website is for instructors, providing them access to exercises, drill questions, reading questions, student activities, and in-class discussion guidance.

It is organized by chapter, with each chapter containing a catalog displaying the available materials for that chapter.

Each file is also a stand-along resource accessible by link. Users can navigate directly to the content they need without going through the catalog. This may be convenient for setting assignments for students.
